g.text: Radial patterns: corrected angular ranges, actual NC cutter footprints
Same 280 mm discs, motif sizes, radii, 1 mm cutter and 0.5 mm engraving depth.
BEFORE: numerals squeezed into a 270° arc
AFTER: four evenly spaced diagonal points
AFTER: twelve numbers aligned with hour ticks
12 at top, 3 right, 6 bottom, 9 left; 30° spacing.
All distinct compass motifs: minimum centerline gap 5.796 mm (> 1 mm full cutter diameter).
Blue: long compass points; brown: short points. Pocket/profile programs and all 60 clock ticks are unchanged.
Matched every SVG path to emitted NC within 0.002 mm. Measurement details and NC hashes: angular-placement-measurements.json.
